Among voters whose self-reported race is black, 62.7% are correctly classified, which rounds to 0.63.

**Method:**
- I dropped voters with any missing value. I then merged them with the surname and voting-district tables and dropped rows that failed to match, which left 8,021 voters. Of those, 1,078 are black.
- For each voter I computed P(race | surname, residence) in proportion to P(race | surname) × P(race | district) / P(race). I took P(race) from the statewide population shares implied by the district data.
- I assigned each voter to the race with the highest probability and compared it to their self-reported race.

ANSWER: 0.63
